# Fire Risk North

> At Fire Risk North, we are committed to ensuring the safety and well-being of businesses and organisations across the United Kingdom. Fire safety is a critical aspect of any premises, and we are here to help you assess and mitigate fire risks efficiently and comprehensively. We provide accredited fire risk assessments, fire safety strategy documents, fire door surveys and inspections, fire alarm testing, fire extinguisher servicing, and emergency lighting compliance across Manchester, Liverpool, and the North West.

## Business & Contact Information

## Fire Safety Services
- [Services Overview](https://firerisknorth.com/services): Full directory of risk assessments, surveys, testing, and engineering services.
- [Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment): Comprehensive PAS 79 compliant fire risk assessments for business premises and residential blocks.
- [Fire Strategy Services](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-strategy): Detailed technical fire strategy documents supporting planning permission and Building Regulations Part B compliance.
- [Fire Door Inspection](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-door-inspection): Periodic compliance checks verifying condition, hardware, clearances, and integrity.
- [Fire Door Surveying](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-door-surveying): Detailed surveys assessing certification, frames, intumescent seals, and self-closing mechanisms.
- [Fire Alarm Testing](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-alarm-testing): BS 5839 maintenance, system commissioning, audibility testing, and logbook compliance.
- [Fire Extinguisher Servicing](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-extinguisher-servicing): Annual testing, recharging, and siting in accordance with BS 5306 standards.
- [Emergency Light Testing](https://firerisknorth.com/services/emergency-light-testing): BS 5266 compliance testing, functional flicker checks, and full 3-hour discharge tests.

## Fire Risk Assessments by Property Type
- [Flats Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/flats): Dedicated assessments for converted residential properties and purpose-built blocks of flats.
- [High-Rise Buildings Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/high-rise-buildings): Building Safety Act compliant assessments for multi-storey residential and commercial developments.
- [HMO Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/hmo): Specialised assessments tailored to council licensing conditions for Houses in Multiple Occupation.
- [Care Homes Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/care-homes): Life safety reviews addressing vulnerable occupants, progressive horizontal evacuation, and staff emergency training.
- [Hospitals & Healthcare Facilities](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/hospitals): Life safety and escape route assessments for clinics, wards, and complex medical centres.
- [Offices Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/offices): Workplace safety compliance, occupancy loads, and evacuation strategies for corporate facilities.
- [Retail Stores Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/retail): Public safety, stockroom hazard mitigation, and clear escape route assessments for retail outlets.
- [Restaurants Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/restaurants): Safety audits focusing on commercial kitchen extraction, cooking equipment, and patron egress.
- [Hotels Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/hotels): Guest safety, sleeping accommodation compliance, fire warning systems, and night-time evacuation plans.
- [Schools Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/schools): Fire risk prevention and emergency drill planning for academies, colleges, and schools.
- [Warehouses Fire Risk Assessment](https://firerisknorth.com/services/fire-risk-assessment/warehouses): Risk evaluation covering high bay racking, pallet storage, charging areas, and industrial logistics facilities.
